description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Holy/Fire, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Basch (Holy)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Basch (Holy)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Basch (Holy) after using a Fire or Holy ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Ruin Impendent+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.10 each), grants [HP Stock (2000)] to the user

description.name: Clash of Light and Flame+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Basch (Holy)
description.text: One single attack (3.31) capped at 99999, grants [100% Critical 3] to all allies

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
